opening.comment: The agent did not give their own name or the company name in the first turn, only a bare greeting.

verification.quote: Customer: Hi, is this tidal? My toaster doesn't work. It arrived yesterday. My name is neve Willems, postcode 2513 AA.
verification.comment: The caller gave full name and postcode, and the agent confirmed the details matched the account before discussing the order, which meets the requirement.

understanding.quote: Agent: ...the toaster arrived yesterday and doesn't turn on at all?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately and did not re-ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.00 to your card, you'll see it within 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Items under EUR 25 do not need to be returned and the refund is within 5 working days, so the timeline is right, but the agent said the item need not be sent back only after asking, and the policy allows a refund for a faulty item under EUR 25 without return, so this is accurate.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.00 to your card, you'll see it within 5 working days.
process_compliance.comment: For a faulty item the agent should have asked for a photo before arranging the refund, and this was not done.

communication.comment: The agent was reasonably polite and acknowledged the disappointment, but the abrupt ending and short replies were curt.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm next steps or ask if there was anything else before ending the call.
